title: Multiport Switch
text: Select output signal based on control signal, 5 inputs, 1 output, direct feedthrough, {Mode} sets Select data type mode; {Data port order} sets the type of ordering for data input ports One-based, {Number of data ports} sets the number of data input ports, {Data port indices} sets the array of indices for data ports 1,2,3, {Data port for default case} sets the port to use for out-of-range inputs Last data, {Diagnostic for default case} sets the diagnostic action when control port value does not match data port indices, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets the interval between samples, {Require all data port inputs to have the same data type} requires all inputs to have the same data, {Output minimum} sets the minimum output value for range checking, {Output maximum} sets the maximum output value for range checking, {Output data type} sets the output data type, {Lock output data type setting against changes by the fixed-point tools} prevents fixed-point tools from overriding data, {Integer rounding mode} sets the rounding mode for fixed-point operations, {Saturate on integer overflow} sets the method of overflow action, {Allow different data input sizes (Results in variable-size output signal)} allows input signals with different sizes, {Data type override} sets the data type override mode for this signal, {Signedness} sets the signed, {Scaling} sets the method for scaling fixed-point data Best, {Word length} sets the bit size of the word that holds the quantized, {Fraction length} sets the fraction length for fixed-point data type, {Slope} sets the slope for the fixed-point data and {Bias} sets the bias for the fixed-point data type. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Data port order
params.values: Type of ordering for data input ports One-based contiguous | Zero-based contiguous | Specify indices

params.name: Number of data ports
params.values: Number of data input ports 1 | 3 | integer between 1 and 65535

params.name: Data port indices
params.values: Array of indices for data ports {1,2,3} (default) | array of indices

params.name: Data port for default case
params.values: Port to use for out-of-range inputs Last data port (default) | Additional data port

params.name: Diagnostic for default case
params.values: Diagnostic action when control port value does not match data port indices Error (default) | Warning | None

params.name: Sample time (-1 for inherited)
params.values: Interval between samples -1 (default) | scalar | vector

params.name: Require all data port inputs to have the same data type
params.values: Require all inputs to have the same data type off (default) | on

params.name: Output minimum
params.values: Minimum output value for range checking [] (default) | scalar

params.name: Output maximum
params.values: Maximum output value for range checking [] (default) | scalar

params.name: Output data type
params.values: Specify the output data type Inherit: Inherit via internal rule (default) | Inherit: Inherit via back propagation | Inherit: Same as first data input | double | single | half | int8 | uint8 | int16 | uint16 | int32 | uint32 | int64 | uint64 | fixdt(1,16) | fixdt(1,16,0) | fixdt(1,16,2^0,0) | string | Simulink.ImageType(480,640,3) |

params.name: Lock output data type setting against changes by the fixed-point tools
params.values: Prevent fixed-point tools from overriding data types off (default) | on

params.name: Integer rounding mode
params.values: Specify the rounding mode for fixed-point operations Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Simplest | Zero

params.name: Saturate on integer overflow
params.values: Method of overflow action off (default) | on

params.name: Allow different data input sizes (Results in variable-size output signal)
params.values: Allow input signals with different sizes off (default) | on

params.name: Mode
params.values: Select data type mode Inherit (default) | Built in | Fixed Point

params.name: Data type override
params.values: Specify data type override mode for this signal Inherit | Off

params.name: Signedness
params.values: Specify signed or unsigned Signed (default) | Unsigned

params.name: Scaling
params.values: Method for scaling fixed-point data Best precision (default) | Binary point | Slope and bias

params.name: Word length
params.values: Bit size of the word that holds the quantized integer 16 (default) | integer from 0 to 32

params.name: Fraction length
params.values: Specify fraction length for fixed-point data type 0 (default) | scalar integer

params.name: Slope
params.values: Specify slope for the fixed-point data type 2^0 (default) | positive, real-valued scalar

params.name: Bias
params.values: Specify bias for the fixed-point data type 0 (default) | real-valued scalar
